hyperedges.label: Tour fare publishing and enquiry flow

nodes.label: FAQ Kel-Taobat fare answer generated from TourFare (faq.ts)
nodes.norm_label: faq kel-taobat fare answer generated from tourfare (faq.ts)

nodes.label: Structured data (schema.ts) without aggregateRating
nodes.rationale: Deliberately no aggregateRating/review and no durations or distances; departs from PROMPT.md Phase 7 which asked for aggregateRating 4.9/705.

nodes.label: Review count from Settings ratingCount (704 vs 705)
nodes.norm_label: review count from settings ratingcount (704 vs 705)

nodes.label: Kel/Sharda to Taobat jeep fare keyword opportunity
nodes.norm_label: kel/sharda to taobat jeep fare keyword opportunity
nodes.rationale: Nobody in the top 5 publishes a fare; our published Kel and Sharda fares answer the search directly.

nodes.label: Tours 'How it works' three-step strip
nodes.rationale: Guests who assume every tour starts at the resort never message.

nodes.label: Jeep tours mixed fare model
nodes.rationale: Regular routes get published fares to prove the operation is real; everything else quoted on WhatsApp because fare depends on starting point. Framed as deliberate choice, not a gap.

nodes.label: Setting key/value model (whatsapp, pickupPoints, ratesUpdated, seasonBanner)
nodes.norm_label: setting key/value model (whatsapp, pickuppoints, ratesupdated, seasonbanner)

nodes.label: TourFare model (per pick-up point)
nodes.rationale: Fare depends on where the guest is picked up, so a Tour never carries a single price.

nodes.label: Phase 7 - Polish (metadata, JSON-LD, sitemap, a11y, rate limit)
nodes.norm_label: phase 7 - polish (metadata, json-ld, sitemap, a11y, rate limit)

nodes.label: Taobat Valley fares (Kel 14-16k, Sharda 20-22k PKR per jeep)
nodes.norm_label: taobat valley fares (kel 14-16k, sharda 20-22k pkr per jeep)

nodes.label: Keyword research (Phase 7 Step 1)
nodes.rationale: Collected 21 Sep 2026 on google.com gl=pk; no search volumes; one primary keyword per page.

nodes.label: Price per jeep, range with reason, ratesUpdated line
nodes.norm_label: price per jeep, range with reason, ratesupdated line
nodes.rationale: Jeep hire quoted per vehicle; a range without a reason reads as arbitrary; ratesUpdated protects owner from stale fuel-price numbers.

nodes.label: DeferredImage / below-fold deferral
nodes.rationale: Chrome's lazy-load threshold is ~2,500px on slow networks, so below-the-fold photos are deferred manually.

nodes.label: ISR revalidate=3600 + revalidatePath on admin save
nodes.norm_label: isr revalidate=3600 + revalidatepath on admin save
nodes.rationale: A guest hitting the homepage should not touch the database.

nodes.label: Phase 6 - Admin CRUD (Enquiries, Rooms, Tours, Gallery, Branding, Settings, Users)
nodes.norm_label: phase 6 - admin crud (enquiries, rooms, tours, gallery, branding, settings, users)

nodes.label: Stack (Next.js 15, Prisma, Neon, Cloudinary, Auth.js, Zod, Render)
nodes.norm_label: stack (next.js 15, prisma, neon, cloudinary, auth.js, zod, render)
nodes.rationale: Render Starter chosen because Vercel free tier bars commercial use; no UI/state/animation/image libraries to stay as light as the reference.

nodes.label: loading.tsx only under [slug] routes
nodes.rationale: A site-level loading.tsx caused 0.44 CLS.

nodes.label: Server action pattern (Zod validate, session check, write, revalidatePath)
nodes.norm_label: server action pattern (zod validate, session check, write, revalidatepath)

nodes.label: /ref-images route (design-reference image server)
nodes.rationale: Phase 3 serves images from design-reference so /public stays empty; checks magic bytes; deleted in Phase 4.

nodes.label: Brand assets (logo-light, logo-dark, favicon, og-image)
nodes.rationale: Two logo files because header flips colour transparent->solid; every slot needs an inline-SVG code fallback; favicon cache-busted with ?v=updatedAt.

nodes.label: lib/cloudinary.ts URL helpers (imageUrl, videoUrl, posterUrl, logoUrl, faviconUrl)
nodes.norm_label: lib/cloudinary.ts url helpers (imageurl, videourl, posterurl, logourl, faviconurl)
nodes.rationale: Never store full URLs; f_auto,q_auto turns a 6 MB phone photo into ~120 KB WebP. Favicon forces PNG; SVG delivered raw with fl_sanitize.

nodes.label: Media pipeline (signed direct upload to Cloudinary)
nodes.norm_label: media pipeline (signed direct upload to cloudinary)
nodes.rationale: Browser uploads directly so a 200 MB video never passes through a serverless function; secret stays server-side.

nodes.label: Phase 4 - Cloudinary (seed only what is correct)
nodes.norm_label: phase 4 - cloudinary (seed only what is correct)
nodes.rationale: bonfire.jpg, kahwa.jpg, dining.jpg, hero-3.jpg show wrong subjects; a wrong photo is worse than none, so sections degrade gracefully.

nodes.label: Desktop-only autoplay video
nodes.rationale: Under 900px or saveData, render poster only; guests on valley mobile data. Hero video capped at 12s.

nodes.label: Graceful degradation of unseeded media sections
nodes.norm_label: graceful degradation of unseeded media sections

nodes.label: Rule: All media from Cloudinary, never /public
nodes.norm_label: rule: all media from cloudinary, never /public

nodes.label: Rule: Mobile first (360px)
nodes.rationale: Owner runs admin from a phone in a valley with weak signal; guests on mobile data.

nodes.label: src/lib/copy.ts page copy
nodes.rationale: Holds FAQ, quotes, stats, feature grids: content with no database model and no admin screen.

nodes.label: Phase 2 - Database first
nodes.rationale: No page is ever built against temporary data, so no page has to be rewritten later.

nodes.label: Phase 5 - Auth and admin shell (Auth.js Credentials, middleware)
nodes.norm_label: phase 5 - auth and admin shell (auth.js credentials, middleware)

nodes.label: Database before pages principle
nodes.rationale: Nothing is hardcoded in a page and no page is rewritten later to switch to the database.

nodes.label: design-reference Layout Notes (scrambled filenames)
nodes.rationale: Second design drop arrived with every text file under the wrong name; mapping table records what each file really contains.

nodes.label: Missing story.jpg photograph
nodes.rationale: Rename loop overwrote the real JPEG with the Gallery page HTML; client must re-send the photo.

nodes.label: PHASE 3 ADDENDUM CSS block
nodes.rationale: Second drop had no stylesheet; eight classes (.steps, .step, .room__foot--stack, .tour__fares, .tour__wa, .fare-table, .rates-note, .pickup) written from tokens. Only non-port part; delete when real style.css arrives.

nodes.label: Design tokens (ink, pine, brass, sand, cream; Cormorant Garamond + Jost)
nodes.norm_label: design tokens (ink, pine, brass, sand, cream; cormorant garamond + jost)

nodes.label: 'If Claude Code drifts' correction lines
nodes.rationale: Most common failures: extra libraries, design mismatch, email form or tour price.

nodes.label: Deliberately untargeted keywords
nodes.rationale: No location pages for places not operated (Kel, Arang Kel hotels); no 5-star claims; no room-price terms because of rule 3.

nodes.label: Rule: No Discounted Offers section
nodes.rationale: Reference site roameoresorts.com has one; ours deliberately does not.

nodes.label: Rule: No email, WhatsApp only
nodes.rationale: Every guest interaction goes to wa.me; the only enquiry record is the DB row.

nodes.label: Rule: Rooms show no prices, tours fares only where published
nodes.norm_label: rule: rooms show no prices, tours fares only where published

nodes.label: PickupSelect pick-up selector
nodes.rationale: Only composes the WhatsApp message; no price updates or fetching.

nodes.label: Open window first, save enquiry second
nodes.norm_label: open window first, save enquiry second
nodes.rationale: window.open after an await is blocked by Safari/Chrome; reaching WhatsApp is the priority even if the save fails.
